subject: Capacity bridging MAP & evaluation window
messages:
From: Sam Rhee <sam@helio.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@helio.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity bridging MAP & evaluation window

Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move from POC to a staged commitment, but before we sign we need a clear mutual action plan that folds in: Dedicated vs Private lead times, recommended GPU pool sizing for our workload, and a short evaluation window we can run with your team. High level constraints:
- Target production launch in Q3; must plan procurement/ordering schedules now.
- Data residency: US-east primary, some on-prem processing in our Palo Alto lab.
- Initial workload: batch embeddings + multi-turn chat, peaky traffic (mornings).

Can you send a MAP draft that:
1) Lists realistic lead times for Dedicated reserved capacity vs Private (VPC/on-prem) installs.
2) Recommends an activation buffer (tranche sizes) and a scaling cadence for GPU pools.
3) Shows a 2-week perf evaluation plan (what we run, success metrics, who owns what).
4) Call out any procurement or SOC2 artifacts you need up front.

We'd like to lock a 2-week evaluation window in April if possible. Also include any procurement contact or docs so our finance team can prepare.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Rhee
Head of Platform, Helio Diagnostics
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rhee <sam@helio.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity bridging MAP & evaluation window

Sam —

Appreciate the clear asks. Draft MAP attached (MAP_draft_v1.pdf) — summary below and next steps. I kept the plan conservative on lead times so your procurement build-out has slack.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Evaluation window: 2-week activation run (preflight + perf + stability), we recommend an April 3 start to align with our operations calendar.
- Evaluation cluster: 16 x H100-equivalent (shared staging pool) with standard KV-cache enabled and prefix caching for embeddings tests. Target metrics: 99th percentile token latency < 200ms for chat flows and embedding throughput > 4k/sec sustained on batch runs.
- Dedicated (reserved) delivery lead time: 10-12 weeks from signed SOW for initial tranche (up to 64 H100-equivalent). We can stagger delivery: 1) 16 GPU activation (week 10), 2) scale to 32 (week 12), 3) full 64 (week 14) — depending on hardware availability.
- Private (VPC / on-prem) delivery lead time: 12-18 weeks for a fully on-prem package (includes network review, install window, HSM/KMS setup). If site prep is complete we can compress to 10-12 weeks; longest delays are rack/network provisioning and customer MTR.
- Activation buffer recommendation: keep a 20% buffer (burst capacity) in the first 90 days; operationally we recommend tranche-based scaling every 4–6 weeks tied to traffic signals.
- Pricing & procurement notes: include reserved capacity ramp credits in SOW for first 3 months to offset evaluation costs; Ben is copied to scope discounts.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 snapshot, data retention and audit log export described in appendix. I attached a SOC2 extract for procurement review (SOC2-extract.pdf).

Preflight / Evaluation plan (2 weeks):
Week 0: kick (Ops & network preflight), provide test dataset and sample prompts, enable KV snapshot.
Week 1: stability & latency runs (chat 95/99pct, embedding throughput).
Week 2: edge cases, scale burst tests + handoff readout and go/no-go.

Next steps:
- Confirm evaluation start: Apr 3?
- Please share your procurement contact and preferred billing entity.
- If you want tighter lead times for Dedicated, we can run a priority procurement lane for an additional fee; Ben can outline tradeoffs.

I attached the MAP draft and SOC2 extract. If that looks ok I'll convert the MAP into an executable MSA appendix and propose a tranche schedule.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 380KB)
Attachment: SOC2-extract.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Ben / Lauren —

Forwarding Sam's asks and the MAP draft I just sent. Key negotiation points I expect:
- Discount for first 3 months (Ben: can you sketch 15% vs 25% scenarios tied to a 12-month commit?)
- SLA tier: they requested production-level latency targets; consider pushing them to Dedicated tier 2 with a 99.9% uptime SLA.
- SOC2 extract attached (SOC2-extract.pdf) — procurement will ask for more evidence.

Operational asks: Lauren, can your team confirm we can hold an activation cluster (16 H100-equivalent) Apr 3–17? If not, propose alternatives.

I'll hold off on final MSA appendix until we confirm discounts.

—Priya

Priya / team —

Thanks — the plan looks sensible and we appreciate the conservative lead times. We can confirm the following from Helio:
- Evaluation window: Apr 3–17 confirmed. We'll provide a 100GB test corpus and a small set of production-like prompts.
- Procurement contact: procurement@helio.ai (cc'd) — please send SOW + preliminary invoice for the evaluation tranche and activation buffer.
- Security: NDA is already in place; we'll need the SOC2 extract and a contact for a short security Q&A next week.

Request: can you include a short appendix in the MAP that lists rollback/fallback behaviors if Dedicated capacity is delayed by >2 weeks (e.g., temporary routing to hosted tier, burst to cloud marketplace)? That will help our platform team sign off.

If you can get the SOW & invoice over by Monday we'll start internal approval.

Best —
Sam Rhee
Head of Platform, Helio Diagnostics
